The '''''ShaShore''-class frigate''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that served in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and later in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] over a hundred years afterwards. A fast and versatile starship, the ''ShaShore''-class saw extensive use during the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and the subsequent [[Second Imperial Civil War|operations]] that followed. Many of these frigates were part of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] [[Core Fleet|fleet]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:GAshuttle_Legacy_9.jpg|thumb|left|100px|Interchangeable front blade of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]].]]

Like its larger cousin, the [[MC140 Scythe-class main battle cruiser|''Scythe''-class battle cruiser]], the ''ShaShore''-class was designed with a large, blade-like structure centered on the ventral section of the ships's bow.<ref name="LECG" /> In its standard armament configuration, the ''ShaShore'' was equipped with multiple [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense cannons]], and a pair of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] batteries.<ref name="LECG" /> The ship's port and starboard hangar bays were capable of housing up to twenty four [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]]s and two [[Crix-class diplomatic courier shuttle|''Crix''-class shuttles]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Role==
The ''ShaShore''-class frigate was designed for greater speeds and maneuverability, at the cost of less armor.<ref name="LECG" /> A smaller blade positioned directly in front of the main blade was designed to carry one of several specialized modules, ranging from barrage-style [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers, to an advanced [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite or communication jammers.<ref name="LECG" /> ''ShaShore'' frigates often were deployed as escorts for ''Scythe''-class battle cruisers. At the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Dac]], at least four ''ShaShore''-class frigates and several [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|''Sabertooth''-class assault ships]] served as the escort for Admiral Stazi's flagship [[Indomitable (Scythe-class)|''Indomitable'']].<ref name="SWL21">[[Legacy (2006) 21|''Legacy'' (2006) 21]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:Fleet_leaving_shramar.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] task force during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] included at least one ''Shashore''.]]
The ''ShaShore''-class had a predecessor design that served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TFNSC">{{WebCite|url=http://boards.theforce.net/threads/star-wars-11-its-a-trap-aka-no-way-can-nick-not-like-the-cover.50014404/page-2|text=TheForce.net Literature forum thread|archivedate=20131119005944}}</ref> An early model of the ''ShaShore''-class was used during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and participated in the [[Battle of Shramar]].<ref name="I16" />

The ''ShaShore''-class frigate later became part of a larger program of Galactic Alliance warships produced at the [[Mon Calamari Shipyards/Legends|Mon Calamari Shipyards]] in the decades following the defeat of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="LECG" /> Unlike larger designs such as the ''Scythe''-class battle cruiser and [[Tri-Scythe-class frigate|''Tri-Scythe''-class frigate]], which were purpose-built, the ''ShaShore''-class was capable of being augmented to numerous other secondary roles.<ref name="LECG" /> Many ''ShaShore''-class frigates fought at the [[Battle of Caamas]], with at least one being destroyed by heavy Imperial fire.<ref name="Indomitable, Part 1">[[Legacy (2006) 20|''Legacy'' (2006) 20]]</ref> Following the formation of the Galactic Alliance Remnant, remaining ''ShaShore''-class frigates saw continued heavy usage, as both a warship<ref name="Indomitable, Part 1" /> and diplomatic courier.<ref name="Trust Issues, Part 1">[[Legacy (2006) 9|''Legacy'' (2006) 9]]</ref>

One ''ShaShore'' transported Admiral Gar Stazi to [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] to conduct negotiations with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mingo Bovark]] of the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] faction loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="Trust Issues, Part 1" /> In the months following the aborted negotiations on the Wheel, several of the frigates were part of a task force under Admiral Stazi that captured the [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|Advanced Star Destroyer prototype]] [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']] during the Battle of Dac. That major victory gave the Alliance a must needed morale boost, as well as a state-of-the-art capital ship prototype.<ref name="SWL21" />

Later in [[137 ABY]], numerous ''ShaShore''-class frigates were part of a combined GA-Fel loyalist operation against [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] naval forces.<ref name="Renegade">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ShaShoreClassFrigatePredecessor-SW2013-11.jpg|thumb|left|180px|''ShaShore''-class predecessor serving in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].]]
In its first appearance, the frigate was accidentally named a ''Sabertooth'', which is the name of another [[Sabertooth-class assault/rescue vessel|Galactic Alliance vessel]].<ref name="Trust Issues, Part 2">[[Legacy (2006) 10|''Legacy'' (2006) 10]]</ref>

Until the publication of the ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', there was no confirmed class name for the ''ShaShore'' frigate.<ref name="LECG" />

When drawing the cover for [[Dark Horse Comics]] [[Star Wars (2013) 11|''Star Wars'' (2013) 11]], artist Sean Cooke added a detail showing an aging ''ShaShore''-esque ship as part of the Rebel Alliance fleet.<ref name="TFNSC" />
